1.w: A prayer of David. Lord, consider my just cause. Pay attention to my cry for help. Listen to the prayer I sincerely offer.

2.w: Make a just decision on my behalf. Decide what is right.

3.w: You have scrutinized my inner motives; you have examined me during the night. You have carefully evaluated me, but you find no sin. I am determined I will say nothing sinful.

4.w: As for the actions of people — just as you have commanded, I have not followed in the footsteps of violent men.

5.w: I carefully obey your commands; I do not deviate from them.

6.w: I call to you because you will answer me, O God. Listen to me! Hear what I say!

7.w: Accomplish awesome, faithful deeds, you who powerfully deliver those who look to you for protection from their enemies.

8.w: Protect me as you would protect the pupil of your eye. Hide me in the shadow of your wings.

9.w: Protect me from the wicked men who attack me, my enemies who crowd around me for the kill.

10.w: They are calloused; they speak arrogantly.

11.w: They attack me, now they surround me; they intend to throw me to the ground.

12.w: He is like a lion that wants to tear its prey to bits, like a young lion crouching in hidden places.

13.w: Rise up, Lord! Confront him. Knock him down. Use your sword to rescue me from the wicked man.

14.w: Lord, use your power to deliver me from these murderers, from the murderers of this world. They enjoy prosperity; you overwhelm them with the riches they desire. They have many children, and leave their wealth to their offspring.

15.w: As for me, because I am innocent I will see your face; when I awake you will reveal yourself to me.
